faqs.question: What is the FOCO model and how does it benefit the franchise partner?
faqs.answer: FOCO stands for "Franchise Owned, Company Operated". In this model, you provide the initial capital and own the physical franchise asset and business rights, while Sugartown’s expert corporate team manages 100% of the day-to-day operations—including hiring & training artisan candy makers, supply chain logistics, customer service, and marketing. This allows you to enjoy passive business returns without the operational headaches of running a retail store.

faqs.question: What are the available investment formats and total capital requirements?
faqs.answer: Sugartown offers two primary investment formats: the ₹25 Lakh Express Kiosk / High-Street Boutique (150–250 sq.ft) ideal for high-density mall atriums and boutique high-streets, and the ₹50 Lakh Flagship Experiential Lounge (400–750 sq.ft) featuring a full 360° Live Candy Theater stage, custom masterclasses, and an expansive gifting lounge. Both formats are turnkey and include franchise fees, interiors, specialized machinery, live theater stage setup, technology, initial stock, and training.

faqs.question: How is profitability calculated and are returns guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Sugartown does not guarantee financial returns, as all retail performance depends on location, footfall, market conditions, and operational execution. However, our transparent financial model projects an indicative operating margin of 20%–30% with an estimated payback period of 18–30 months under standard business assumptions. Our live ROI Calculator allows you to stress-test these projections with custom revenue and cost variables.

faqs.question: What makes Sugartown different from ordinary candy or confectionery stores?
faqs.answer: Sugartown is India’s pioneer in "Live Candy Theater" and experiential retail. Rather than simply selling packaged sweets, we transform confectionery into an engaging sensory performance where customers watch master artisans pull, shape, and hand-craft custom rock candies live on heated stages. This creates unmatched footfall pull, high social media virality, and significant margins through bespoke corporate and wedding gifting.

faqs.question: Who handles staff recruitment, candy-making training, and store staffing?
faqs.answer: Sugartown corporate headquarters handles end-to-end recruitment, background checks, and master culinary training for all store staff. Our certified artisans undergo rigorous training in candy artistry, food hygiene SOPs, and customer showmanship at our Pune training center before deployment.

faqs.question: How do you assist with site selection and lease negotiations?
faqs.answer: Our dedicated retail expansion analytics team conducts comprehensive footfall, demographic, and catchment studies before approving any retail location. We actively assist in negotiations with Grade-A mall developers and high-street property owners to secure favorable commercial lease terms and optimal store placement.

faqs.question: What ongoing support does Sugartown provide after store launch?
faqs.answer: Franchise partners receive complete support including centralized raw material and packaging supply chain, cloud-connected POS with real-time financial auditing, national marketing campaigns, festive seasonal SKU releases, continuous staff skill upgrades, and quarterly business performance reviews.

faqs.question: How long does it take from signing the agreement to the grand opening?
faqs.answer: Typically, the entire process takes between 4 to 8 weeks from lease signing to store launch. This includes turnkey civil & interior fit-out (3–4 weeks), specialized machinery installation, staff onboarding & training (2 weeks), and pre-launch marketing activation.
